manuscript_title: Temperature Drift at the heated chamber

evidence.quote: Under steady conditions, the sensor measured 14 K at the heated chamber.
The comparison uses a reference sensor at the same heated chamber.

rows.text: Both protocols concern the heated chamber. The field record gives 14 K, while the separate reference checks the instrument in that setting.
rows.difference: The field observation and the separate reference use distinct instruments.
rows.gap: The earlier protocol recorded temperature drift at the heated chamber only under steady conditions.
rows.response: We report a bounded measurement of 14 K.
rows.boundary: Only the steady condition was observed; the temperature drift outside that condition was not measured.
